# Tokens the docs name on purpose that check-doc-refs cannot verify.
# One token per line; a `#` line is a comment. Group by reason.
# File names and paths need no entry: a `.ts/.tsx/.mjs/.md/.json` name resolves
# against the tail of any tracked path, so only placeholders and patterns belong here.

# Extension fragments, not whole files.
.fake.spec.ts
.mjs
.ts

# Git-ignored or generated files, absent from `git ls-files`.
.mcp.json
progress.md
settings.local.json

# Spec file stems: the docs name the spec by its subject, and the file is <name>.spec.ts.
uploadRateLimit
writeRateLimit

# Placeholders and patterns, not real files.
.superpowers/sdd/<topic>/ui-check.md
<name>Repository.contract.testkit.ts
<name>Repository.spec.ts
NNNN-name.ts
docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md
docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-followups.md
repositories/<name>Repository.fake.testkit.ts
…-codemap.md

# Alias and URL examples.
@/components/organisms/BookCard/BookCard
/books/:id/chapters/:chapterId/edit

# Repositories on GitHub, outside this tree.
AntonLab/books_spa
AntonLab/custom-agents-swarm

# Properties, columns and methods (Type.member, table.column) whose parent is a real
# type or table. The member alone is found in code, the dotted form is not.
BookDetail.commentCount
BookDetail.favoriteCount
DataTypes.JSONB
bookRepository.update
books.seriesPosition
chapterRepository.update
chapters.wordCount
classNames.body
comments.userId
likeRepository.create

userController.assertCurrentPassword
userController.assertMayTouch
users.emailNotifications

# Names that live in third-party libraries or other repos, not here.
SendMessage
afterCreate
refetchPage
res.json

# tsconfig options the docs name as left off on purpose (tooling.md), so no tracked file spells them.
exactOptionalPropertyTypes
noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature
